Docs.summary: Specifies the color space gamma in which an image is rescaled during an asynchronous read-pixels request.

remarks.format: Passed to `RequestReadPixels` to control the gamma space used when the image is resized to the requested dimensions. Rescaling in linear gamma is more accurate but slower, while rescaling in the source gamma is faster.

MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype SkiaSharp.SKImageRescaleGamma Linear = int32(1)

Docs.summary: Rescale in a linear gamma color space for higher accuracy.
